description: ClickHouse's spec marks no response member required, so createService's answer types `service` and `service.id` optional, and a caller must handle a create without the new service's ID. Both are always present: listServices returns `id` on every service (live, 2026-11-13), and ClickHouse's Terraform provider (ClickHouse/terraform-provider-clickhouse at 66ecf4fa, internal/api) decodes `result.service` from the create response and waits on its `id` at once. Marking ServicePostResponse.service and Service.id required lets callers read the ID without checking for undefined.
